note: All inputs are fictional. Scores come from the rule weights in script.js. A low score never means an input is safe.

cases.input: URGENT: Your bank account will be blocked today due to incomplete KYC. Verify immediately at http://bank-kyc-update.example.com or your account will be suspended. Do not delay!

Link with a possibly deceptive domain
